items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Great trumpet player, Joe Guy -- I did a lot of dates, single dates with these guys... They'd have a 12 piece band, you know.

ctx.x: -- and bebop was going there. A guy named Joe Guy, who was the first husband, I believe, of the late Billie Holiday, he played a gang of name with bebop. Another little old guy had a name named Benny, trumpet player, you (inaudible) know him.
